comparison.objective: Tear the front panel from a loaded shelf-ready tray along its perforations.
comparison.physical_skill: Restrain a heavy tray while directing a controlled peel/tear along designed lines.
comparison.success_condition: Panel fully removed on the perforation without tray displacement, tipping, product loss, or residual panel; released and still.
comparison.reason: Tests controlled tearing of packaging under reaction load, not threaded adjustment or lock retention.
